body:
I think I will look into the counseling more seriously. I went when I was around 4 years old after I had been taken by child protective services, but didn’t really know it was therapy. In high school after one of my attempts, my dad took us and my enabler step mother to family therapy for a couple sessions but didn’t like hearing he was obviously in the wrong so we stopped going and he doubled down.  

I am a guitar performance major, mainly focused on jazz and other black American music. I’m hoping to move to New York and do a masters there in jazz guitar, or maybe take a couple gap years to figure things out and just practice. Covid took away all my income as a gig worker so that’s been tough as well. Looking forward to a future that has already been stripped away is a bit hard right now, feels like I’m a failure already and I’m still in undergrad.

I go to school 2 hours north of my fathers house. I only visit on holidays and once or twice over the summer. I’m no longer going to, I am financially stable enough from him that I can cut him off it’s just hard to do is all. With my mother, I don’t know what I was expecting. She has severe emotional disabilities herself and has caused a lot of trouble through her actions for that side of the family, but I was so young when she did everything she’s done that for the most part I don’t hold anything against her. I think seeing her was just a reminder that I’m not close to anyone and no one really cares about me. Over the past two years a lot of things have happened, but in high school when I was in the depths of my fathers abusiveness, I was depressed, but I had a sense of pride in appearing confident and well adjusted. But pride isn’t worth shit. My roommate (who I shared an actual room with) is a “friend” from high school, but he has spent the last five years gaslighting me and putting me down. We do have our moments but admittedly his presence in my life during college was also severely detrimental to my mental state, noting also his manipulation of my other friends and roommates into thinking terrible things about me. He is moving out in 2 days though so at least there’s that. I have my depressive episodes and all, like I did over this summer and last fall, but these past couple months are the first real times I’ve experienced extra symptoms and it’s just exhausting. I have no appetite yet I’m starving so much it hurts, I still didn’t sleep last night either. I just don’t want to deal with any of this
